nodes.label: Work Overlay
nodes.rationale: Full-screen immersive overlay showing the 5 discipline cards in aikawakenichi cylinder style; scoped to the 5 disciplines only. Services is deliberately NOT part of it because it has its own admin section and is a real revenue path.

nodes.label: Page Activity Toggle (isActive)
nodes.rationale: Scoped to the 5 discipline pages only; inactive pages excluded from Work overlay and homepage sections, direct URL redirects to homepage. Services/About/People/Blog/Contact/Testimonials intentionally excluded as they aren't disciplines.

nodes.label: Homepage WebGL Scene (camera-on-a-rail)
nodes.rationale: One persistent full-page R3F canvas; Lenis scroll drives a GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub moving the camera along a 3D spline, each section a station. Built photography-first to prove the technique cheaply before extending across five disciplines. Text stays real DOM for SEO and admin-editability.

nodes.label: Ice/Frost Look (animated shader)
nodes.rationale: It's ice not glass: frosted/crystalline with visible fracture and shimmer. Hero ring uses MeshPhysicalMaterial + clearcoat (NOT MeshTransmissionMaterial, which is for clear refraction) plus a Voronoi-cell crystal shader and high-frequency sparkle noise. Every other surface uses a cheaper faked-ice version.

nodes.label: Hero Ring (hero-ring.glb)
nodes.rationale: Delivered asset: Meshy image-to-3D from the reference image crop, cleaned in Blender (decimate 587K to 234,822 triangles, Draco-compressed, Meshy textures stripped since the ice material replaces them). Every other shard is procedural, not authored.

nodes.label: Preloader
nodes.rationale: Shipped Session D1. Runs on every visit to / (no sessionStorage gate). Symbol sequence (Camera, Video, Bitcoin, dancing emoji pair, Code2) then Art/Hussain reveal in Cormorant Garamond. Built with useGSAP. Needs an onComplete-prop contract change before D2d handoff.

nodes.label: Photography Viewer (3 modes)
nodes.rationale: 3D Cylinder (Three.js textures), horizontal scroll (GSAP ScrollTrigger), and category filter. All modes reuse existing search/filter logic.

nodes.label: Page Transitions (content-as-animation)
nodes.rationale: Every transition uses the actual photos/videos on each page as animation material; no generic overlays. Shared GSAP+Three.js transition context aware of origin/destination images.

nodes.label: Exhibition Globe
nodes.rationale: react-globe.gl on homepage, data from appearances.kind === 'exhibited' only. Open question whether it becomes a station inside the WebGL scene or a DOM section after the rail.

nodes.label: People Page (privacy system)
nodes.rationale: Public by default with a private-per-person password toggle and a removal-request system; on approval content is hidden behind a password, never deleted.

nodes.label: Dancing Page
nodes.rationale: Interim: Instagram feed embed + title + description + booking CTA; no direct media upload. Reviewed after launch for expansion (Session D10).

nodes.label: Web Development Page
nodes.rationale: Displays completed web projects + related services with admin CRUD (web_projects collection, Session D11).

nodes.label: Blog
nodes.rationale: Standard blog with admin-defined categories; full CRUD, listing at /blog and article at /blog/[slug] (Session C1).

nodes.label: page_seo collection
nodes.rationale: One doc per public page storing both on-page header (headerTitle/headerDescription) and search/social metadata (title/description/ogImageUrl). Two conceptually distinct groups on the same document, edited at /admin/seo (labeled Page Content).

nodes.label: PageHeader component
nodes.rationale: Shared h1+description for all public page headers. Props title/description/className/titleClassName. No eyebrow prop (removed in N4 due to inconsistent usage across only 4 of 11 pages).

nodes.label: PortfolioCard component
nodes.rationale: All full-bleed image cards with overlay. Reusable component to never reinvent.

nodes.label: AnimatedText component
nodes.rationale: Word-mode only, scroll-triggered via ScrollTrigger. Does not support char/line modes despite other doc references; the preloader deliberately does NOT route through it.

nodes.label: HeroBokeh component
nodes.rationale: Self-contained raw-Three.js 180-point shader particle system, properly disposed. Its particle technique gets ported into the R3F scene as atmosphere in D2a; the raw-Three.js pattern is not extended further.

nodes.label: Navbar component
nodes.rationale: Visual design frozen as N1 shipped it; a camera-hump redesign was explored and explicitly dropped.

nodes.label: AppShell component
nodes.rationale: Lenis initialized here; all global elements live here. Mounts Preloader only when pathname === '/'. Skips Lenis on admin routes.

nodes.label: 6-item Navigation
nodes.rationale: Work · About · Services · People · Testimonials · Book. Corrected from the original 3-item spec; Services kept intentionally, People/Testimonials added in N8 as flat top-level links.

nodes.label: DOM-sync Overlay System
nodes.rationale: Projects a 3D anchor to screen space each frame and drives a real DOM element's transform, keeping the h1 a real heading for SEO and admin copy editable.

nodes.label: Design Tokens (OKLCH)
nodes.rationale: OKLCH color tokens in globals.css, never hardcode hex. Radius rule (rounded-xl/2xl/3xl) is stale vs 83 arbitrary rounded-[Xrem] instances actually in use.

nodes.label: section-shell class
nodes.rationale: mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 container class; many page.tsx files write it inline instead, scheduled to be swapped in F4. Three files intentionally use different widths.

nodes.label: Animation Stack
nodes.rationale: Lenis, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Three.js/R3F, react-globe.gl, Framer Motion — all active on every public page per the design standard.

nodes.label: Design Standard (benchmarks)
nodes.rationale: Must match aikawakenichi.com, ten.375.studio, igloo.inc: WebGL-first homepage, content-as-animation transitions, photography as primary visual identity.

nodes.label: Queue Protocol (3-gate cycle)
nodes.rationale: Triggered by 'Continue queue': Gate 1 Plan (stop for confirm), Gate 2 Execute (stop for confirm working), Gate 3 Commit (stop for push confirm). Re-read task list before marking done.

nodes.label: react-three-fiber + drei
nodes.rationale: Chosen over raw Three.js for the persistent camera rig, multiple content stations, and dozens of DOM-sync'd elements. R3F manages that lifecycle instead of hand-rolling it.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Persistent knowledge graph at graphify-out/ with god nodes and community structure; query/path/explain preferred over raw grep for codebase questions.
